title: Shop
trust: Cosmetics, coaching and club capacity only. Nothing here changes the tiles you draw.

coach.body:
Free: coach at the table, daily puzzle, drills, lessons 1–3, 1 hand review and 1 Puzzle Rush per day, Beginner and Club bots.
Gold: all lessons, unlimited Puzzle Rush, Pro bots, review history.
Platinum: unlimited hand reviews, puzzle battles, luck dashboard.
Diamond: move-by-move explanations, insights, club-table discounts.

vip.body: Prepaid, no auto-renew. Every table look while active, an emote allowance, one extra club slot and one extra review per day. Days carry over when you upgrade.

club.title: Club capacity
club.body: Starter clubs are free: 30 members, 2 managers, one live table. Owners upgrade capacity with diamonds or a 30-day plan. Members never pay to play in a club.

foot: Prices shown are placeholder USD tiers; your store shows local pricing at checkout. Subscriptions renew until cancelled in your store account settings. This build uses a mock store: purchases are instant and free.
